app.name: Sahayak
app.shortDescription: Offline-first reference and productivity tool for central government officers.

common.disclaimer: Reference only; verify with the official gazette/order or your DDO.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: This section failed to load. Your saved data is safe on this device.

law.title: Law Converter
law.subtitle: IPC ⇄ BNS · CrPC ⇄ BNSS · Evidence Act ⇄ BSA
law.emptyBody: Bidirectional section mapping, aware of the offence date, arrives in a later session.

pay.title: Pay & Allowances
pay.subtitle: 7th CPC matrix, allowances, deductions and tax
pay.emptyBody: Level and cell lookup, post-specific allowances and take-home comparison arrive in a later session.

draft.title: Drafting Studio
draft.subtitle: Every CSMOP 2022 document type, with live A4 preview
draft.emptyBody: Office memoranda, notings, notifications and the Hindi administrative glossary arrive in a later session.

learn.title: Rules Trainer
learn.subtitle: Spaced repetition over conduct, leave, pension and financial rules
learn.emptyBody: Bilingual questions with rule citations, scheduled by FSRS, arrive in a later session.

utils.title: Utilities
utils.subtitle: Holiday calendar, leave, pension and glossary
utils.emptyBody: Holiday calendar, leave and pension calculators and the portals directory arrive in a later session.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, appearance and stored data
settings.privacyBody: Everything you enter stays on this device, in your browser's storage. There is no account, no server and no analytics.

ai.sectionSubtitle: Off by default. With AI off this app makes no network request of any kind.
ai.consentRequired: Read and accept the AI notice before these settings can be changed.

banner.label: AI notice
banner.title: AI answers can be wrong.
banner.classified: Do not enter official, sensitive or classified content, file numbers, or anything that identifies a person.
banner.verify: Check every section number, figure and date against the source shown before you act on it.
banner.leavesDevice: What you type is sent off this device.
banner.staysOnDevice: Nothing you type leaves this device on this setting.

consent.title: Before you turn on AI
consent.intro: Sahayak works fully without AI. Turning it on changes what leaves this device, so read this first.
consent.classified: Never enter official, sensitive or classified content, departmental file numbers, or anything that identifies a person. Nothing in this app can undo that once it has been sent.
consent.storage: A key you enter is encrypted with AES-GCM and stored only in this browser. It is sent nowhere except to Anthropic, as your own credential. Code running on this page could still read it — encryption at rest is not protection against that.
consent.cost: Sahayak is free and takes no payment. With your own key, Anthropic bills you directly for every request. You set a monthly token limit here and the app stops at it.
consent.accept: I have read this — enable AI

local.name: On this device
local.leaves: Nothing leaves the device. The model runs inside your browser.
local.cost: Free, after a large one-time download.

byok.name: Your own Anthropic key
byok.leaves: Your question, the app's instructions and the records it looked up are sent to Anthropic.

proxy.name: Shared service
proxy.leaves: The same content is sent to this app's operator, who forwards it to Anthropic.

tierHint.off: No AI surface is shown and no request is made.
tierHint.local: Arrives in a later session, once the on-device model ships.
tierHint.byok: Paste a key from your Anthropic console. It stays in this browser.

model.label: Model
model.hint: Sonnet is the default: these answers are lookups over bundled tables, not open reasoning.

key.label: Anthropic API key
key.hint: Stored encrypted on this device only. Revoke it any time from your Anthropic console.
key.present: A key is stored on this device.
key.invalid: That does not look like an Anthropic key.

test.note: Sends exactly one request, of one token, when you press it.

budget.label: Monthly token limit
budget.hint: A hard stop. When this month's total reaches it, a run refuses to start.
budget.exhausted: This month's limit is used up.

cache.label: Reuse recent answers
cache.hint: A repeated question is answered from this device instead of being sent again. Questions about you are never stored.

kill.title: Turn everything off
kill.body: Switches AI off, deletes the stored key and the key that encrypts it, and clears cached answers and the token count.
kill.confirm: Delete the stored key and every cached answer?
kill.done: AI is off and nothing was left behind.

errors.ungrounded: The answer was not backed by anything the app looked up, so it was discarded.
errors.invalid_citation: The answer cited a source that does not support it, so it was discarded.
errors.budget_exhausted: This month's token limit is used up.
errors.max_steps: The assistant did not finish within the allowed number of steps.
errors.truncated: The answer was cut off before it finished, so it was discarded rather than shown half-written.
errors.no_key: No key is stored on this device.
errors.not_installed: The on-device model is not part of this build.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
errors.provider: The AI service could not be reached.
errors.tool_timeout: A lookup took too long to answer.
errors.invalid_args: The assistant could not call a lookup correctly.
errors.unknown_tool: The assistant asked for a lookup that does not exist.

search.label: Search a section, an offence or a phrase
search.hint: Section numbers, English, Hindi or roman-Hindi. Press / to search from anywhere.

direction.label: Direction
direction.followed: Read as {{act}}, because the search names it.

date.label: Date of offence
date.hint: Which code applies is decided by this date, not by today's.
date.none: No offence date given, so this page does not say which code applies.
date.oldTitle: Old law applies — IPC, CrPC and the Indian Evidence Act, 1872.
date.oldBody: The offence predates 1 July 2024, so it is investigated, tried and punished under the repealed Acts. See BNSS section 531(2) — the saving provision.
date.newTitle: New law applies — BNS, BNSS and BSA.
date.newBody: The offence is on or after 1 July 2024, the date all three Sanhitas came into force.
date.invalid: That is not a date this app can read. Use the date picker.

results.reasonOther: The same number, read the other way
results.startTitle: Type a section number or a word
results.startBody: "302" for the number you already know, "sec 438 crpc", "hatya", "anticipatory bail" — all of them work. Or pick a code above to read that Act end to end.
results.emptyBody: Check the number, or try a word from the offence instead. Every section of all three Sanhitas is on this device.
results.errorTitle: The section tables could not be loaded
results.errorBody: They are bundled with the app, so this usually means the download was interrupted. Try again.
results.truncated: Showing the first {{count}} matches. Narrow the search to see fewer.

card.noCounterpart: No provision in the repealed Act
card.noText: The source publishes no text for this section.
card.numberOnly: Only the number changed. The wording of the heading is the same.
card.diffBody: The repealed heading compared with the one in force. The section text of the repealed Acts is not published by the source, so only the headings can be compared.
card.diffNone: The heading is word for word the same.
card.classificationNone: The BNSS First Schedule lists no entry for this section.
card.classificationProcedural: This Act is procedural. Cognizable, bailable and compoundable are properties of offences under the BNS.
card.curatedHindi: The Hindi on this card is a Sahayak translation, not the statutory Hindi. Verify against the official gazette.

actions.copyFailed: The browser would not let this app use the clipboard.

whatsNew.title: What changed on 1 July 2024
whatsNew.subtitle: The additions, the renumberings and the provisions that went, each pointing at the section itself
whatsNew.intro: Every bullet below names a provision and links to it. The heading and the text come from the section record on this device, not from a summary written here.

groups.procedure: BNSS: duties with a clock on them

saved.title: Saved sections
saved.subtitle: Kept on this device, with your recent lookups
saved.favouritesEmptyBody: The bookmark button on any section card keeps it here. Saved sections never leave this device.
saved.recentsEmpty: Sections you open appear here — the last 20.
